newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA corn export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 554,000 MT were 56 percent above the previous week and 6 percent more than the 4-week average.
Major increases were reported for Japan (100,700 MT), South Korea (80,400 MT), Mexico (76,500 MT), Israel (72,400 MT), and unknown destinations (64,500 MT).
Sales of 341,500 MT for delivery in 1997/98 were primarily for Japan (121,700 MT), Taiwan (94,000 MT), and South Korea (78,800 MT).
Exports of 589,800 MT were one-tenth lower than the week earlier and 12 percent less than the 4-week average.
The principal recipients were Japan (215,700 MT), Mexico (74,900 MT), the Philippines (54,900 MT), and South Korea (54,100 MT).
